footnotes.text: A window is valid when (length − count of its most common letter) ≤ k: keep the majority letter, replace the rest.
maxf is never decreased when shrinking. That's safe: the answer can only improve when some letter's count beats the old maxf, so a stale maxf never produces a wrong (too large) best.
